display_title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-DRS-04 Enhancing preparedness for large-scale cross-border disasters – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-DRS-04 Enhancing preparedness for large-scale cross-border disasters
executive_summary: Funds Innovation Actions that develop and validate VR/AR and digital-twin crisis simulation and training platforms for disaster responders, emergency management personnel and decision makers facing large-scale, cross-border disasters such as wildfires, floods, earthquakes and industrial accidents, plus transnational training frameworks and lessons-learned platforms in coordination with the EU Civil Protection Mechanism training programme, reaching TRL 8. At least 3 national authorities in charge of disaster risk or crisis communication from 3 different Member States or Associated Countries must be beneficiaries; entities controlled from China are excluded. Paid as a lump sum; indicative topic budget EUR 8 million for around 2 projects of around EUR 4 million EU contribution each. Forthcoming: planned opening 5 May 2027, single-stage deadline 4 November 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 6 (Civil Security for Society), pp. 124–126, HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-DRS-04 Expected Outcome and Scope, funds VR/AR and digital-twin simulation training for civil-protection responders and decision makers, with transnational training frameworks and lessons-learned platforms linked to the EU Civil Protection Mechanism. The topic names no energy, grid or critical-infrastructure-operator element: its hazards are wildfires, floods, earthquakes and industrial accidents and its users are emergency services and disaster-risk authorities, so no project file is close (TwinEU and the Digital Twin Programme share only the words resilience and digital twin, applied to the grid). The call therefore does not touch TenneT's field.
